summary: Crowdfund Insider reports that Base, the Coinbase-backed layer-2 network, has put tokenized versions of Apple, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon shares onchain, as the tokenized stock market reaches $3.84B. The headline notes pushback from the issuers themselves, meaning the underlying companies appear to object to these tokenized versions of their stock. The signal matters because it captures rapid growth in tokenized equities alongside rising friction between crypto platforms and the companies whose shares are being tokenized without their blessing.
reason: All three mentions were confirmed as existing shelves. Base is the subject of the report, so its tokenized-stock expansion is an existing story developing there. Coinbase appears only as Base's backer, making it a plain update rather than a story about Coinbase itself. The $3.84B market size and issuer pushback are data points for the tokenization/RWA topic, continuing its existing story. Framed as a Crowdfund Insider report, not an announcement by any of the entities.
